title: `meta-plural-i18n.test.ts`'s header restates the translatable-type set by hand, and is stale by one since `dataset` registered
body:
Observation, filed rather than fixed. Same defect class as #14378 but a different carrier, and #14378's recorded triage scoped that card to a single line in `rest-server.ts` ("Scope, and it is genuinely one line"), so this was measured and handed back rather than folded in.

### What

`packages/rest/src/meta-plural-i18n.test.ts:11`, in the file header, restates the translatable-type set by hand:

> `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` — a set DERIVED (#3786) from `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`' keys, and those keys are singular-only: `view` / `action` / `object` / `app` / `dashboard` / `page`.

### Measurement, on `origin/main` @ `9e9f03abe21`

Dispatch table keys, read mechanically out of `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` rather than by eye:

```
count=7 ["view","action","object","app","dashboard","dataset","page"]
```

The header names six. `dataset` is missing: `translateDataset` was registered by #14253, which landed **after** #14378's triage was written — that triage recorded `git grep translateDataset -- packages/` returning **0** on 2026-09-02, and it returns hits today.

Population scan for hand-written restatements of this set, over 7660 tracked files (control: the same pattern fires on the two known sites before the fix, so the scan is not silently empty):

| site | verdict |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:3254` | fixed by #14378 |
| `packages/rest/src/meta-plural-i18n.test.ts:11` | **this card** |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts:3039` | deliberately NOT a defect — it is the recorded rationale for the 17.0.0 `book.translations` retirement and describes the set as it stood at that removal. #14378's triage fenced it explicitly, and rewriting it would falsify a historical record. |

So once #14378 lands, the live population is exactly one: this file.

### Why it is worth a card

Nothing breaks — it is prose in a test file. But it is the header of the test that *pins this exact behaviour*, so it is the first thing a reader consults before touching the translatable-type predicate, and it currently understates the set. The dispatch table's own doc comment already states the rule this violates: "Derived from the dispatch table — never restate it."

### Suggested disposition

The same one #14378 took: delete the enumeration and keep the point (the keys are singular). The clause immediately before it already names both `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` and `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`, which is where a reader should go. Do not "correct" it to seven — a corrected restatement rots again on the next registration, which is the whole finding.

### Considered and rejected

A lint gate forbidding restatement anywhere. It would have to permanently exempt `registry.ts` by name, i.e. maintain a hand-written list of "places allowed to restate the set" — the same defect class one level up, bought for a live population of one.
